title: The Hymn of Marrow Creek
author: Ines Okafor
blurb: Juniper Eastwick, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
